gaps.lead: Nobody else in the team runs as fast as Maya.
gaps.explanation: nobody runs faster = she is the fastest runner.

gaps.lead: We couldn't see the lighthouse anywhere.
gaps.explanation: Fronted 'nowhere' forces inversion: Nowhere could we see…

gaps.lead: He had just got home when the power cut happened.
gaps.sentence: ___ home when the power cut happened.

gaps.lead: She left early because she didn't want to miss the train.
gaps.explanation: so as not to / in order not to + infinitive.

gaps.lead: Someone stole her bike last week.
gaps.explanation: have something stolen/done = experience it happening to you.

gaps.lead: A mechanic repaired my father's roof last week.
gaps.explanation: have something done = arrange for somebody to do it: had his roof repaired.
